mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 57 degrees with overcast skies over the Verona Community Park area.

The city has announced that Highway M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 to allow for asphalt and shoulder work near the new Aldi development, so please follow the posted detour signs. Additionally, remember to keep your planning application fees to checks delivered by mail or in person, as the city will never request wire transfers or credit card payments online.
We have a busy schedule today including the Dane County Farmers Market, plus live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from September 5, Verona officers responded to reports of cheese slices placed on windshields across several streets, identified as a social media prank.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so you have until 10:30 PM tonight to stop in and enjoy a scoop.
